chunks: O believers, remember the favours God bestowed on you when a people raised their hands against you and He restrained their hands. So fear God; and the faithful should place their trust in God.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about God restraining the hands of enemies?
ai.summary: This verse, revealed during the expedition of Dhat al-Riqa, highlights the divine protection of the believers from the Banu Qurayza and other tribes who prepared to attack them. It serves as a foundational reminder in Shia exegesis that physical safety is a manifestation of God's grace, necessitating both taqwa and tawakkul as complementary spiritual responses to historical trials.
